Factset Returns the Job History of the Person.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of FactSet Person Entity identifier.

params.name: status
params.description: Select only Jobs with a certain status primary, active, or inactive.

params.name: level
params.description: Select the level of detail only main Jobs or include other Jobs at a company.

params.name: type
params.description: Select only Jobs of a certain type board member or employee.

items.docs: Returns the `Job` history of the person referenced by the entityId specified in the request.

info.name: Factset Get Details for the Given Prb Job

params.name: attribute
params.description: The attribute parameter accepts a list of the given enums, separated by commas. Each of them returns the respective data associated with the job. Runs returns the run history of the job.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to fetch the documents, tasks, accounts, and/or runs for the PRB job given in the path. Please note jobs with type PD will not return tasks nor accounts so this will be ignored if given as part of the array of attributes in the request.
